date_policy: Keep nonempty current descriptions/summaries as unverified retrospective text. Keep posts only when their stored date is strictly before Day 30, with no conflicting date for identical platform/text. This screening does not authenticate publication or historical text.
graph_policy: Future step: one independent graph per source document, shared fixed security TPG, namespaced node IDs and source_text_type on nodes/edges. No invented links across documents. Reuse fixed description graphs where source hashes match.
fusion_policy: Future step: pool graph representations within each source, then combine source representations and presence masks with the EPSS encoder. Missing sources contribute no text and are masked, not replaced with invented text.
comparison_rules: Same CVEs and frozen train/validation assignment in every comparison; no complete-case filtering.
New matched EPSS-only and description-plus-EPSS controls required for any changed fusion architecture.
Same initialization/seed, batch schedule, loss, optimizer, training budget and checkpoint rule where architecture permits.
Report every prespecified seed, actual source coverage and effective missing-source masks.
Choose document/token limits from training-only information before training; never silently truncate.
No test access or training at this stage; training protocol remains pending source/graph preview.
limitations: Stored summary fields are not evidence of source-page availability or factual accuracy.
A reference-addition date does not authenticate the webpage contents.
Post dates are supplied values; their presence does not prove original publication time.
Undated descriptions and summaries remain retrospective even when late posts are excluded.
Source text may itself mention exploitation or later events; excluding structured label fields is not sufficient to guarantee leakage-free text.
Current study predicts EPSS Day 60, not exploitation or VulnCheck inclusion.
Existing validation has informed development; it is not an independent final test.
